title: feat(app-shell): the sidebar entry's ⋯ menu, one component for every entry type (part of objectui#12427)
body:
Part of #12427
Clause-②: yes

objectui#12427 (the card, its addendum comment 6184739946, and the scope note comment 6186841419). The sidebar half and the list-header half are complete. One item is left, outside this change's files: the record page header still draws its star (see "What is left").

## What this PR does

- **One ⋯ menu on every sidebar entry, in place of the pin icon** (`SidebarItemMenu`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`). Hovering an entry shows one ⋯ trigger (hover-revealed, the objectui#1055 rule), and a right-click on the row opens the same menu. The entries derive from the entry's type, never from a product (ADR-0060):
  - Add to favorites / Remove from favorites always comes first. It writes the same `nav:ID` pin as before, through `useNavPins().togglePin`.
  - Open in new tab and Copy link use the address the row's link renders, so they keep the router basename. A URL off the console is used verbatim.
  - Design appears for `object`, `dashboard` and `page` entries. It opens `/apps/APP/metadata/TYPE/NAME`, the metadata-admin route `PageView`'s Edit-in-studio button already uses, and only when `isAdmin && canAuthorMetadata`.
  - On a phone, navigation entries show no trigger, as they showed no pin icon.
- **One Favorites section, at the top.** The non-nav favorites (an object, a record, an app) were a group after Recent. They are now rows of the Favorites section, after the pinned entries and outside their drag order.
  - Each row shows its stored label and type icon and carries the same ⋯ menu. Its favorites entry removes the favorite.
  - Design shows for `object:`, `dashboard:` and `page:` ids, never for records or apps.
  - The store is not touched and nothing is migrated.
  - `sidebar.favorites` was read only by the removed group, so it leaves the ten packs. The console-home Starred group and the Home page are unchanged.
- **`NavigationRenderer` (`@object-ui/layout`) gets two additive props.**
  - `renderItemAction(item, context)` is a host control drawn on every leaf and action row, in place of the pin action. `context` is `NavItemActionContext`: `href`, `external`, `label`, `basePath`.
  - `extraFavorites` takes host rows appended inside the Favorites section, which renders when either kind of row exists.
  - A host passing neither keeps the pin action and the pinned-only section, objectui#12059 drag order included.
- **The list header's favorites entry lives in an overflow menu.**
  - #12436 removed the star. The actions row now ends with an icon-only ⋯ button named by `detail.moreActions`, the name the record header's ⋯ already uses.
  - Its menu holds the favorites entry, the same `FavoriteMenuItem` the sidebar menu leads with.
  - When the current app's navigation, as the member is shown it, has an `object` entry for this list, the entry pins that navigation entry. The result is one `nav:ID` favorite with `pinned: true` and no `object:` favorite.
  - For an object the app does not list, the entry keeps the `object:NAME` favorite.
- **The record page's header overflow** leads with the record favorite (`sys_favorite`), ahead of Share.
- Six new `console.nav` keys in all ten packs. Changeset `.changeset/12427-sidebar-item-menu.md` is minor for app-shell, layout and i18n.

## What is left (one item, outside this change's files)

The record header star is drawn by the `page:header` renderer in `@object-ui/components` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, through `RecordTitleChip`). Its `showStar` defaults to true from the schema alone, whether or not the host wires a toggle. If `RecordDetailView` stopped passing `isFavorite` / `onToggleFavorite`, the star would stay and store nothing. So the record page keeps its wired star next to the new overflow entry for now.

The proposed follow-up has three parts:
- draw the star only when `RecordContext` carries `onToggleFavorite`;
- drop the two props in `RecordDetailView`;
- pin the star's absence.

## Tests and gates (at `0bc0189`)

- **New tests:**
  - `SidebarItemMenu-12427.test.tsx` (15): entry rosters, Design route, basename, right-click.
  - `NavigationRenderer.hostItemAction-12427.test.tsx` (8): the slot in place of the pin, its context, host rows, and the default for a host that passes neither.
  - `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427.test.tsx` (10): one ⋯ per row and no pin; 4 entries for an admin, 3 for a non-admin; nav pin written and reading Remove; no trigger on a phone; stored `object:` / `record:` favorites at the top and the store not rewritten; Favorites before the menu and Recent, with no group after Recent.
  - `ObjectView.favoritesEntry-12427.test.tsx` (3): no star, the ⋯ last; one `nav:nav_projects` pin and no `object:` favorite, reading Remove, then removed; the `object:` fallback.
  - `RecordDetailView.favoritesEntry-12427.test.tsx` (2).
- **Deliberate update:** `UnifiedSidebar.pinnedOrder-12059.test.tsx` drives the ⋯ menu instead of the pin icon. Its starred record now reads as a row of the same section, after the pinned entries.
- **Ablations** (each landed, went red, was restored to the HEAD blob):
  - no host control on leaf rows: 8 red;
  - no host favorites rows: 6 red;
  - no navigation lookup in the list toggle: 1 red;
  - from the earlier round, the Design authoring gate and the off-console URL check: 1 red each.
- **Union run** of `packages/layout/`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`, `packages/i18n/` and every other test naming the sidebar or the renderer: 218 files, 2512 passed. The `RecordDetailView*` and `ObjectView*` suites: 124 files, 961 passed.
- **Type checks:** `type-check` for layout, i18n and app-shell exits 0, and the test tsconfigs list every new test file.
- **Local gates:** `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, the three vi-mock checks, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, changeset presence and no-major all exit 0.
- **CI on `0bc0189`:** 34 success, 3 skipped.
- An earlier head, `122909d`, failed `objectView-config-keys-retired-4730` ("expected 103 to be 102"). A new `console.objectView.moreActions` key had grown that namespace's surviving-key ledger. Fixed in `0bc0189` by reusing `detail.moreActions`; no key was added.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`.
